ios.desc:
Barqly Partner is the vendor app for restaurants and food businesses on Barqly.

The app helps approved vendors manage daily store operations, receive new orders, accept or reject orders, update preparation status, manage menu products, update business details, configure operating hours, view analytics, track payouts, receive notifications, manage verification documents, and contact support.

Vendors can also manage store locations, bank details, reviews, notification settings, team access, security, privacy, and account settings.

Barqly Partner is intended only for registered vendors approved to sell through the Barqly platform.

android.desc:
Barqly Partner helps restaurants, stores, and local merchants manage orders and run day-to-day operations from one app.

Use the app to monitor incoming orders, manage your store profile, view order activity, update business details, and stay connected with your customers through a streamlined partner dashboard.

With Barqly Partner, you can:

Sign in and manage your partner account
View and handle incoming customer orders
Monitor order status and fulfillment activity
Manage store details and business information
Review customer feedback and ratings
Access sales, order, and account-related information
Stay updated with support and operational notifications
Barqly Partner is designed to give merchants a simple and reliable way to manage store operations and respond to orders efficiently.

Download Barqly Partner and manage your business with confidence.

quotes.text:
I’ve been building software for the last few years, mostly working directly on products rather than just doing small freelance tasks.

Web apps, mobile apps, backend systems, payments, real-time systems, admin panels, deployments, the whole thing. Some of the products I’ve worked on are already live.

But honestly, right now things are a little quiet. I don’t have any active client work, and I’m looking for the next thing to work on.

So if anyone here has a project that needs a developer, needs help finishing something, or knows someone looking for a Software Engineer / Full Stack Developer, I’d genuinely appreciate you reaching out.

I’m comfortable taking something from an existing codebase and fixing/building it, or starting something from scratch.

Some of my work (https://vijeetshah.com/):
